import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import lax

x = jnp.linspace(0.1, 8.9, 100, dtype=jnp.float32)
g = jnp.full_like(x, 1.3)

_, jvp_pos = jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (x,), (g,))
_, jvp_neg = jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (-x,), (g,))
jvp_diff = jnp.abs(jvp_pos - jvp_neg)
probe("jvp_max_abs_diff", float(jnp.max(jvp_diff).item()))
probe("jvp_diff_count", int(jnp.sum(jvp_diff != 0).item()))

grad_fn = jax.vmap(jax.grad(lambda z: jnp.float32(1.3) * lax.tanh(z)))
gp = grad_fn(x)
gn = grad_fn(-x)
grad_diff = jnp.abs(gp - gn)
probe("grad_max_abs_diff", float(jnp.max(grad_diff).item()))
probe("grad_diff_count", int(jnp.sum(grad_diff != 0).item()))

fixed.tanh_jvp_grad_symmetry:
import jax, jax.numpy as jnp, numpy as np
from jax._src.lax import lax

x = jnp.linspace(0.1, 8.9, 100, dtype=jnp.float32)
g = jnp.full_like(x, 1.3)
_, jvp_pos = jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (x,), (g,))
_, jvp_neg = jax.jvp(lax.tanh, (-x,), (g,))
d_jvp = np.asarray(jvp_pos) - np.asarray(jvp_neg)
probe("max_abs_jvp_asymmetry", float(np.max(np.abs(d_jvp))))
probe("jvp_mismatch_count", float(np.count_nonzero(d_jvp)))

grad_fn = jax.vmap(jax.grad(lambda z: jnp.float32(1.3) * lax.tanh(z)))
g_pos = np.asarray(grad_fn(x))
g_neg = np.asarray(grad_fn(-x))
d_grad = g_pos - g_neg
probe("max_abs_grad_asymmetry", float(np.max(np.abs(d_grad))))
probe("grad_mismatch_count", float(np.count_nonzero(d_grad)))
